title: Low Battery Indicator
fullDescription:
Schlage smart locks use four AA batteries. A red LED plus an alert in the Schlage Home app indicates battery is near depletion. Heavy keypad use and cold weather shorten battery life.

Replace all four simultaneously with the same brand.

fixSteps.title: Install fresh AA batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Remove interior cover and replace all four AAs. Use alkaline (not lithium per Schlage).

faq.a: Schlage recommends alkaline; lithium can confuse the level gauge.

title: Wi-Fi Disconnected
shortDescription: Schlage Encode cannot reach 2.4 GHz network.
fullDescription:
Schlage Encode has built-in 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Router changes, password updates, or weak signal at the door cause disconnection. The lock still works locally via keypad.

Re-run Wi-Fi setup from the Schlage Home app when the network changes.

fixSteps.title: Add mesh node
fixSteps.instruction: If signal is weak at the door, place a mesh AP nearby.

title: Keypad Unresponsive
shortDescription: Buttons do not light or beep when pressed.
fullDescription:
An unresponsive Schlage keypad usually indicates dead batteries, a lockout after failed attempts, or internal moisture.

Check the LED behavior: no LED = power issue; red X = lockout.

fixSteps.title: Wait out lockout
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 30 seconds after 3 incorrect codes before retrying.

whenToCallPro: If moisture damaged the keypad, a locksmith can replace the exterior assembly.

title: Factory Reset Needed
shortDescription: Lock must be wiped to recover from stuck state.
fullDescription:
A factory reset clears all codes, Wi-Fi credentials, and paired phones. Perform this when the lock is unresponsive, after selling a home, or before transferring ownership.

You will need the programming code printed on the inside cover label.

fixSteps.title: Remove one battery
fixSteps.instruction: Open the cover and remove one AA.

fixSteps.title: Hold Schlage button
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold the Schlage button while reinserting the battery. Hold for 10 seconds until beep.

fixSteps.title: Re-enroll in app
fixSteps.instruction: Add the lock as a new device in Schlage Home.

faq.a: Yes, all codes and the Wi-Fi profile are wiped.

title: Lock Jammed
shortDescription: Deadbolt cannot fully extend or retract.
fullDescription:
When the bolt binds against the strike plate or door frame, the Schlage motor stalls and the app reports a jam. Typical causes include misalignment, weather-induced door swelling, or weak batteries.

Align the strike so the bolt throws without resistance.

fixSteps.title: Open door and test
fixSteps.instruction: With door open, operate bolt from app; should work cleanly.

fixSteps.title: Realign strike
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen strike screws, reposition so bolt enters without contact, retighten.

whenToCallPro: If door frame is warped, call a carpenter.

faq.a: No, the motor halts before damage.

title: User Code Rejected
shortDescription: Keypad rejects a previously valid access code.
fullDescription:
Codes can be rejected if the schedule has expired, the code was deleted via app, or the lock is offline and missed the latest sync.

Check the code's schedule in Schlage Home, then re-sync.

fixSteps.title: Verify code in app
fixSteps.instruction: Open Schlage Home > Access > confirm code is Active.

fixSteps.title: Re-push code
fixSteps.instruction: Edit and save the code to trigger a fresh sync.

title: Schedule Did Not Apply
shortDescription: Time-based code schedule failed to sync.
fullDescription:
Recurring or one-time code schedules require the lock to stay online. If the lock was offline during the scheduled push, the schedule will not activate.

Re-sync by opening the lock in the app.

causes.cause: Lock was offline at sync time

symptoms: Code not active in expected window

fixSteps.title: Bring lock online
fixSteps.instruction: Verify Wi-Fi status; re-sync the code.

faq.a: Only if they were synced before the lock went offline.

title: Push Notifications Missing
shortDescription: App does not deliver activity alerts.
fullDescription:
Alerts require the lock online, notifications enabled on the phone, and alert types toggled on in Schlage Home.

Reinstalling the app or toggling notification permissions usually resolves it.

causes.cause: Phone notifications disabled for Schlage Home
Alert types turned off in app

fixSteps.title: Enable phone notifications
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > Notifications > Schlage Home > Allow.

fixSteps.title: Toggle alert types
fixSteps.instruction: App > Alerts > enable each event type.

faq.a: Usually because the lock is on weak Wi-Fi and only reports when polled.

title: Z-Wave Inclusion Failure
shortDescription: Schlage Connect not joining Z-Wave hub.
fullDescription:
Schlage Connect uses Z-Wave Plus. Inclusion can fail if the hub is too far, in the wrong security mode (S0 vs S2), or if the lock was previously paired without being excluded.

Exclude first, then include in S2 mode close to the hub.

fixSteps.title: General Exclusion
fixSteps.instruction: Put hub in exclude mode, press Schlage button 1.

fixSteps.title: Include near hub
fixSteps.instruction: Carry lock within 2 m of hub and include in S2 mode.

faq.a: S2 is preferred for security and speed.

title: Auto-Lock Feature Not Engaging
shortDescription: Door does not auto-lock after configured timer.
fullDescription:
Schlage Auto-Lock engages after 15 seconds to 4 hours. The timer only starts when the door position sensor (on Encode Plus) confirms closure, or on simple time delay (Encode).

Check the Auto-Lock toggle and timer in the app.

fixSteps.title: Verify toggle
fixSteps.instruction: App > lock settings > Auto-Lock > enable and set timer.
